annotation.bound_parties_text: The decree binds the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, Mayors/Do Governors, road management authorities, persons seeking for-hire transport permission or approvals for autonomous vehicles, insurance purchasers, and certification/verification institutions.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: The Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport shall determine whether to designate a pilot operation zone within 90 days from the date of receipt of the application under paragraph (1)
annotation.dates_quote: This Decree shall enter into force on May 1, 2020.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF ACT ON THE PROMOTION OF AND SUPPORT FOR COMMERCIALIZATION OF AUTONOMOUS VEHICLES
